parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own JSON webhook by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-json` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `json://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two Apprise channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters. Two transformer channels skip Apprise entirely and POST a native JSON `{message}` payload directly to your webhook URL: the free `gateway` channel delivers direct to your JSON webhook, and the `gateway-plus` channel adds extra per-enrollment JSON webhook destinations at $0.001 per message.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"message":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and "\n" or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment JSON webhook destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your JSON webhook (no Apprise)

host_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's JSON Webhook host
